facts.fact: Guinea's president signed a decree on 19 August 2026 applying article 1003 of the Civil Code on electronic signature, giving an electronic signature the same probative force as a paper writing, covering public, private and person-to-person acts, and taking effect on signature.
facts.system: Decree applying article 1003 of the Civil Code on electronic signature

facts.fact: The decree of 19 August 2026 requires every electronic-certification service provider to be approved by the competent authority, names the national digital agency ANDE as that authority for approval, control and audit, and refers technical standards to a joint order of the telecommunications and justice ministries; it reports no provider approved.
facts.system: Decree applying article 1003 of the Civil Code on electronic signature
